name: UCP
one_line_zh: 让 Agent、商户和支付提供方使用统一的商业语言完成购物流程。
one_line_en: A common commerce language for agents, businesses, and payment providers.

name: ACP
one_line_zh: 连接商品目录、checkout、订单和受限支付凭证。
one_line_en: Connects merchant catalogs, checkout, orders, and delegated payment credentials.
maturity: Open standard; Instant Checkout approved partners

name: AP2
one_line_zh: 证明 Agent 确实获得用户对具体购买或预授权任务的授权。
one_line_en: Provides verifiable evidence that an agent is authorized to transact.

name: ACT
one_line_zh: 把用户意图、委托授权和跨平台商业执行连接成可追溯信任链。
one_line_en: Connects user intent, delegated authority, and traceable commerce execution.
maturity: Ecosystem protocol; public field-level spec incomplete

name: AMP
one_line_zh: 面向数字钱包、Super App 和移动终端的 Agent 支付协议。
one_line_en: A mobile- and wallet-first protocol for agentic payments.
rails: Digital wallets / APMs; settlement asset varies

name: APOP
one_line_zh: 通过 Agent 身份、结构化意图、用户身份和支付授权建立可信支付链。
one_line_en: Builds a trusted payment chain around agent identity, intent, user identity, and authorization.
rails: UnionPay cards / bank rails / existing payment network

name: x402
org: x402 Foundation / Linux Foundation; origin Coinbase
one_line_zh: 用 HTTP 402 把支付要求嵌入机器访问互联网资源的请求流程。
one_line_en: Embeds payment requirements into HTTP interactions for agents, APIs, and applications.

name: MPP
one_line_zh: 让 Agent 以程序化方式为 API、算力、内容或现实服务按次付款。
one_line_en: An open standard for agents to pay services programmatically.
rails: Stablecoins + cards + BNPL via supported methods

name: A402
full_name: A402 payment method within Alipay Machine Pay
one_line_zh: 支付宝 Machine Pay 中基于 HTTP 402、Payment-Needed 和 Payment-Proof 的 A2M 按量付费方法。
one_line_en: An HTTP-402-based A2M payment method documented inside Alipay Machine Pay.
maturity: Documented product method; not yet classified as independent open standard
